description: Add an invoice for a customer: pass customer_id and amount, and optionally invoice_number, currency (default USD), due_date, status (default draft) and metadata. It does not email the customer; send_invoice does. Needs a claimed Last Price credential with billing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

currency.description: The currency code. Defaults to USD.

customer_id.description: The customer: its id, as list_customers shows it.

due_date.description: When the invoice is due, as an RFC 3339 date-time.

metadata.description: Anything worth keeping with the record.

name: create_invoice
